ios.desc:
The revolutionary photo and gallery cleaner designed to bring a fresh and creative approach to clean up your camera roll. While other photo cleaner apps exist, none compare to the simplicity, enjoyment, and style that Swipe Clean brings to photo, video, screenshot, camera roll cleaning on a month-by-month basis.

Save your time – we've got the answer! While other apps claim to swiftly delete photos, none delivered the magic we craved!

How does Swipe Clean operate? It's as easy as a swipe! Swipe right to preserve a photo or video, left to delete photo or video. Correct any mistakes with a simple tap, or explore a picture's metadata on top right corner. Once you've reviewed all the photos for the month(even without reviewing full month you can quick delete already reviewed files), take a final look to decide which ones to keep and which to delete. When you're done, the month gets crossed out, but you can revisit any month whenever you want.

But that's not all:
• Similar/Duplicate photo remover: Swipe Clean leverages advanced algorithms to analyze your similar/duplicate photos to keep your gallery cleaner.
• Filtering: Swipe Clean offers extensive filtering options, allowing you to tailor your cleaning experience. Choose between cleaning Videos, Photos, Screenshots. 
• Date range: There's a date range feature, enabling you to select photos, videos, screenshots within a specific date range for efficient organization. 
• Quick Clean already swiped files: There is also a cool feature if your camera roll for a specific month is too big, then you can quick delete already reviewed files without swiping all the photos! And you can always come back later to clean the rest of the photos.
• Privacy matters: Clean your photos offline, keeping memories on your device.
• Share: Instantly share your favorite photo with ease!
• Contact manage: Merge duplicate contacts, Delete incomplete contacts and contacts multi delete.
• Similar/Duplicate video detect.
• Video Compressor: Compress videos without loosing quality, on-device.


.. and we continually introduce exciting new features!

Swipe Clean transforms the task of cleaning into a fun and engaging experience!

If you prefer a different approach, or even if you love going month by month, you'll appreciate our new On This Day feature. This feature stays at the top of your Swipe Clean home screen, updating with photos from the same date in previous years, allowing you to relive and decide.

Keep your memory, phone, device,
